subject.title: Feature request: api.callGatewayMethod() for inter-plugin communication

question: Should ordinary external plugins be allowed to invoke plugin-registered Gateway methods, and if so should the surface be raw dispatch, allowlisted request, or typed capabilities?
rationale: The remaining work changes the public Plugin SDK and Gateway authorization boundary, so automation cannot choose the permanent API or trust model safely.

options.title: Design an authorized SDK contract
options.body: Expose only approved methods or typed capabilities with plugin caller attribution, method authorization, docs, and contract tests.

options.title: Keep trusted-only Gateway requests
options.body: Treat the new `api.runtime.gateway.request` surface as limited to bundled or trusted official plugins and decline arbitrary third-party inter-plugin dispatch.

options.title: Allow raw method dispatch
options.body: Expose a generic method string caller and accept the broader compatibility and security surface as an explicit product decision.

recommendation.title: Design an authorized SDK contract
recommendation.body: Expose only approved methods or typed capabilities with plugin caller attribution, method authorization, docs, and contract tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the plugin architecture and is the strongest history match for the public Plugin SDK/Gateway boundary decision.
